rows.grounds: compound: jñāna-śakti-tā; abstract condition of being knowledge-power
logical impossibility or lack of establishment
marks the conclusion of the reasoning

items.question: Why is the condition of being knowledge-power logically untenable?
premises: Knowledge-power is designated in feminine form only by figurative expression.
Figurative designation does not establish a real identical status.
A claimed condition lacking real establishment cannot be logically sustained.
items.inference: Therefore, the condition of being knowledge-power is untenable.
uncertainties: The precise subject to whom knowledge-power-state is being denied is supplied by the broader context.
items.plain_english: And thus, the state of being knowledge-power is untenable.
